name: Shimai Kyoushi ~Haruna to Asuna~
original_name: 姉妹教師　～春菜と明日菜～
source:
Kidnapping happens in a private high school. Two sisters - teacher Haruna and tutor Asuna - start to investigate this case separately, and the story is told from two viewpoints.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一所私立高中发生绑架事件。姐妹二人——教师春菜与家庭教师明日菜——分别展开调查，故事也从两人的视角进行讲述。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
